expectations.text: Names all four: Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands, referred July 8, 2026
expectations.evidence: "On 8 July 2026 the European Commission referred four Member States to the Court of Justice of the EU (IP/26/1499): Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands."

expectations.text: States the Commission requested lump sums and daily penalty payments
expectations.evidence: "The Commission asked the Court to impose lump-sum payments and daily penalty payments."

expectations.text: Gives the procedure history: letters of formal notice November 28, 2024, reasoned opinions May 7, 2025
expectations.evidence: "28 November 2024: letters of formal notice. 7 May 2025: reasoned opinions."

expectations.text: Notes the Netherlands referral has been overtaken by its August 15, 2026 transposition
expectations.evidence: "The Netherlands has since transposed. The Cyberbeveiligingswet... entered into force on 15 August 2026"; expects the case to be withdrawn or narrowed.

expectations.text: Advises that entities in the remaining states should prepare against the directive text because short compliance windows have followed national enactments
expectations.evidence: "Authorities have applied short compliance windows once national law lands, so prepare against the directive text now."
